notes.title: Announcement of the Release of "Madoromi Travel"!
notes.notes:
The title "魔女の脳" is an 旧古 one. "まどろみトラベル" has been released.

With the release, you can purchase it at a 15% discount for a while.
Wouldn't it be fun to have a Golden Week where you fight against drowsiness for about 1 or 2 hours?

Distribution, etc.
Feel free to distribute and create gameplay videos, including monetization.

Bugs, etc.
Please report any bugs or issues here:
https://twitter.com/kyuko4437

If you enjoyed it
It seems that if you could leave a review, it would be more likely to be featured in the store's recommendations.
If you have the time, I would be delighted if you could write one.
